# Display snippets for docs/term_expansion.md

--8<-- [start:quick_example]
# Every fact automatically gets a "logged" wrapper
term_expansion(
    fact(X),
    [fact(X), logged_fact(X)],
    STATE, STATE
),

fact('a'),
fact('b'),
# After expansion, the module also contains:
# logged_fact("a"), logged_fact("b")
--8<-- [end:quick_example]

--8<-- [start:writing_expansion_rules]
term_expansion(INPUT, OUTPUT, MODULE_STATE, NEW_STATE) <- (
    # transform INPUT into OUTPUT
    ...
)
--8<-- [end:writing_expansion_rules]

--8<-- [start:identity_expansion]
term_expansion(ITEM, ITEM, STATE, STATE) <- True
--8<-- [end:identity_expansion]

--8<-- [start:suppressing_items]
# Remove all facts for "debug" predicate
term_expansion(debug(X), [], STATE, STATE) <- True
--8<-- [end:suppressing_items]

--8<-- [start:one_to_many_expansion]
# Duplicate every item (expansion_provider.clausal)
term_expansion(TERM, [TERM, TERM], STATE, STATE) <- True
--8<-- [end:one_to_many_expansion]

--8<-- [start:plain_term_patterns]
# A pattern is a plain term: in argument position it is DATA, never a goal
term_expansion(double_fact(X), [fact(X), fact(X)], S, S),
--8<-- [end:plain_term_patterns]

--8<-- [start:module_state_threading]
# Count clauses as they are expanded
term_expansion(ITEM, ITEM, COUNT, NEXT) <- (
    NEXT == COUNT + 1
)
--8<-- [end:module_state_threading]

--8<-- [start:importing_expansion_rules]
# expansion_provider.clausal
term_expansion(TERM, [TERM, TERM], STATE, STATE) <- True
--8<-- [end:importing_expansion_rules]

--8<-- [start:importing_expansion_rules_ex2]
# my_module.clausal — imports TE rules from provider
-import_from(expansion_provider, [term_expansion])

color('red'),
color('green'),
# Each color fact is duplicated by the imported expansion rule
--8<-- [end:importing_expansion_rules_ex2]

--8<-- [start:regex_auto_binding]
# What you write:
match(r"(?P<YEAR>\d{4})-(?P<MONTH>\d{2})", S)

# What the compiler sees (after expansion):
match(r"(?P<YEAR>\d{4})-(?P<MONTH>\d{2})", S, _G),
YEAR is _G["YEAR"], MONTH is _G["MONTH"]
--8<-- [end:regex_auto_binding]
